skill.summary: Affiliate collaboration — commission structure, creator selection, sample management, performance tracking

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program skill (Beta).

- Provides expert guidance and actionable frameworks for TikTok Shop affiliate collaboration.
- Offers structured assessments, optimization recommendations, and step-by-step implementation plans.
- Supports analysis of commission structures, creator selection, sample management, and performance tracking.
- Outputs include action items, tool/strategy comparisons, and KPI suggestions.
- Focuses on strategic advice; does not provide direct TikTok API integrations.
